limitations: FDA and sponsor disagree on AMP-516 primary p-value (0.10 vs 0.047). No US approval; CRL required another controlled trial. Safety signals cited by FDA (thrombosis, cardiac events, infusion reactions/unblinding risk). Limited independent replication. Results not posted on CT.gov for NCT00215800. Not medical advice.
